wrong.why: The verse's Hashabiah son of Bunni is hashabiah-11 (father of Azrikam), not hashabiah-2, who is the Levitical singer son of Jeduthun (1CH 25:3).
Azrikam is the son of the Hashabiah of this verse (hashabiah-11), which 1CH 9:14 already records; hashabiah-2 is the wrong man.
NEH 11:15 says Bunni was the father of Hashabiah, and that Hashabiah is hashabiah-11 (son of Bunni), not hashabiah-2.
The verse says only that Zechariah was 'the son of the Shilonite'; nothing in the chapter links him to Ahijah.

missing.why: The verse gives Mattaniah as son of Micha, son of Zabdi, son of Asaph, so his descent from Asaph is stated, though Zabdi is not a record.

note: Rows the owner ruled on (103840 ahitub-3 descendant-of aaron at NEH 11:11, 105704 haggedolim descendant-of aaron at NEH 11:14, and 106046 meshezabel-2 descendant-of zerah-3 at NEH 11:24, where the Zerah clause belongs to Pethahiah) look unsupported by their verses, so they are flagged here, not listed as wrong. NEH 11:17 also gives Micha's father as Zabdi, not the Zichri of the 1CH 9:15 chain on mica-2, and Zabdiel's father is only 'one of the great men' with no name, so haggedolim is kept as a label.
